subtitle: Lesson 22 · Private Connectivity: VPN & Dedicated Circuits

eyebrow: A different physical path, not a faster tunnel
code:
Site-to-site VPN:   on-prem -> IPsec tunnel -> PUBLIC INTERNET -> cloud
ExpressRoute/DC:    on-prem -> dedicated physical circuit -> cloud

No shared public medium in the middle --
nothing there to encrypt against.
caption: Not VPN-but-faster. A fundamentally different path, with no public internet involved at all.
